real_task: Accept or rebut Agent 2's revised distutils #433 patch before it can move to human review.
observed_problem: The first patch covered build_py only and its test did not prove it reached the reported cache_from_source failure.
baseline: On pinned upstream, run the revised tests with their guards absent and observe whether both fail with the reported NotImplementedError; compare the original patch's install behavior documented by the reviewer.
hypothesis: The revised two-command patch makes both end-to-end regressions pass, preserves focused tests and adds no failures relative to the same environment's unpatched full-suite baseline.
metric: new regressions passing with no added full-suite failures
unit: regressions out of 2 and added failures
minimum_useful_effect: Improve 0/2 to 2/2 with 0 added full-suite failures and clean format/diff checks.
quality_control: Fresh clone at the pinned commit; exact reviewed patch; both tests must fail for the reported NotImplementedError when guards are absent; compare focused and full-suite outcomes; inspect command-level scope.
overhead: Include mandatory LAB startup, fresh clone and environment setup, baseline and intervention tests, reporting, checkpoint and publication.
stop_condition: Reject or rebut if either test fails for another reason, any new full-suite failure appears, or scope expands beyond build_py/install_lib command handling. Stop before any fork, PR, issue comment or maintainer contact.

result.baseline: With both guards removed, both new tests failed at the intended cache_from_source call with NotImplementedError: sys.implementation.cache_tag is None (0/2).
result.intervention: The exact reviewed patch passed both new regressions (2/2) and both focused modules (14/14).
result.full_suite_ab: On the same Python 3.12 environment, unpatched upstream had 228 passed, 28 skipped and 12 failures; the reviewed patch had 230 passed, 28 skipped and the same 12 failures. Added failures: 0.
result.scope: The install_lib guard is required because install, install --record, bdist_dumb and wheel paths otherwise reach the same unsupported bytecode operation. No upstream side effect was made.

decision_reason: Agent 1 accepts Agent 2's revision: it fixes both independently reproduced command paths, improves the predeclared regressions 0/2 -> 2/2 and adds no full-suite failures in a same-environment A/B comparison. Move the task to human review, not submission.
agent_interaction: Agent 2 challenged the original patch's scope and test validity; Agent 1 independently reproduced both findings and accepted the revised patch.
failures: The available system-Python full suite has 12 failures on both sides because CPython development files are absent and several install assertions are environment-dependent; the suite is not reported as green.
The first LAB coverage check used the incomplete direct-module form and returned invalid_arguments; the canonical package command then reported 22/22 complete.
limitations: This is replay evidence for patch review, not a field trial, LLM-utility result, maintainer approval or authorization to publish upstream.
